classifier_type: GradientBoostingClassifier (scikit-learn), exported as JSON boosted regression trees for pure-JS inference
algorithm_family: Gradient-boosted decision trees (same family as XGBoost/LightGBM: sequential trees fit to residuals). NOT XGBoost itself - see eval_report_gb.json 'algorithm_note' for why.

preprocessing.url_normalization: prepend http:// if no scheme present before parsing
preprocessing.https_handling: is_https is NOT an ML feature; HTTPS is tracked as an informational fact only and never scored as risk evidence in either direction

split_methodology: Domain-aware (group) split: URLs grouped by registrable domain via a real Public Suffix List parser; each domain assigned entirely to train, val, or test. Zero domain overlap verified programmatically (see train_model.domain_aware_split()'s assertions). IDENTICAL split code/seed to the RandomForest model (train_model.py) for a fair comparison.
decision_threshold_note: Both raw and calibrated ML probability are ONE input into PhishGuard's riskEngine.js evidence fusion; ML alone is structurally incapable of reaching the HIGH_RISK verdict (see risk engine weight caps + corroboration policy).
